ud3.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud3.3:1.3: tena kho pana samayena Yasojapamukhāni pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni Sāvatthiṃ anuppattāni honti bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
ud3.3:1.4: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū nevāsikehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodamānā senāsanāni paññāpayamānā pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā ahesum.
ud3.3:2.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud3.3:2.2: ke pan' ete Ānanda uccāsaddā mahāsaddā kevaṭṭā maññe maccha-vilope 'ti .
ud3.3:2.3: etāni bhante Yasojapamukhāni pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni Sāvatthiṃ anuppattāni bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
ud3.3:2.4: te ca āgantukā . . . pe . . . paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā 'ti.
ud3.3:2.5: tena h' Ānanda mama vacanena te bhikkhū āmantehi:
ud3.3:3.1: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā yena te bhikkhū ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etad avoca:
ud3.3:3.3: evam āvuso 'ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Ānandassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū bhagavā etad avoca:
ud3.3:4.1: kin nu tumhe bhikkhave uccāsaddā mahāsaddā kevaṭṭā maññe maccha-vilope 'ti .
ud3.3:4.2: evaṃ vutte āyasmā Yasojo bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud3.3:4.3: imāni bhante pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni Sāvatthiṃ anuppattāni bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
ud3.3:4.4: te 'me āgantukā bhikkhū . . . pe . . . paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā 'ti.
ud3.3:4.5: gacchatha bhikkhave, vo paṇāmemi, na vo mama santike vattabban ti.
ud3.3:5.1: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā, senāsanaṃ paṭisāmetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Vajjī tena cārikaṃ pakkamiṃsu,
ud3.3:5.2: Vajjīsu anupubbena cārikañ caramānā yena Vaggumudā nadī, ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Vaggumudāya nadiyā tīre paṇṇakutiyo karitvā vassaṃ upagacchiṃsu.
ud3.3:6.1: atha kho āyasmā Yasojo vassupagato bhikkhū āmantesi:
ud3.3:6.2: bhagavatā mayaṃ āvuso paṇāmitā atthakāmena hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya.
ud3.3:6.3: handa mayaṃ āvuso tathā vihāraṃ kappema, yathā no viharataṃ bhagavā attamano assā 'ti.
ud3.3:6.4: evam āvuso 'ti kho bhikkhū āyasmato paccassosuṃ.
ud3.3:6.5: atha kho te bhikkhū vūpakaṭṭhā appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharanto ten' ev' antaravassena sabb' eva tisso vijjā sacchākaṃsu.
ud3.3:7.1: atha kho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Vesālī tena cārikaṃ pakkami,
ud3.3:7.2: anupubbena cārikam caramāno yena Vesālī tad avasari.
ud3.3:7.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
ud3.3:8.1: atha kho bhagavā Vaggumudātīriyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manasikaritvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud3.3:8.2: ālokajātā viya me Ānanda esā disā, obhāsajātā viya me Ānanda esā disā
ud3.3:8.3: yassaṃ disāyaṃ Vaggumudātīriyā bhikkhū viharanti gantuṃ appaṭikkūl' āsi me manasikātuṃ.
ud3.3:8.4: pahiṇeyyāsi tvaṃ Ānanda Vaggumudātīriyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ:
ud3.3:8.5: satthā āyasmante āmanteti, satthā āyasmantānaṃ dassanakāmo 'ti.
ud3.3:9.1: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā yena aññataro bhikkhu ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:
ud3.3:9.2: ehi tvaṃ āvuso, yena Vaggumudātīriyā bhikkhū ten' upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā Vaggumudātīriye bhikkhū evaṃ vadehi:
ud3.3:9.3: satthā āyasmante āmanteti, satthā āyasmantānaṃ dassanakāmo 'ti.
ud3.3:10.1: evam āvuso 'ti kho so bhikkhu āyasmato Ānandassa paṭissutvā
ud3.3:10.2: seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evameva Mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyam antarahito Vaggumudāya nadiyā tīre tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ purato pātur ahosi.
ud3.3:10.3: atha kho so bhikkhu Vaggamudātīriye bhikkhū etad avoca:
ud3.3:10.4: satthā āyasmante āmantesi, satthā āyasmantānaṃ dassanakāmo 'ti.
ud3.3:11.1: evam āvuso 'ti kho te bhikkhū tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā senāsanaṃ paṭisāmetvā pattacīvaram ādāya
ud3.3:11.2: seyyathā . . . pe . . . sammiñjeyya, evamevaṃ Vaggumudāya nadiyā tīre antarahitā Mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ bhagavato sammukhe pātur ahesuṃ.
ud3.3:11.3: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā ānañjena samādhinā nisinno hoti.
ud3.3:11.4: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
ud3.3:11.5: katamena nu kho bhagavā vihārena etarahi viharatī 'ti.
ud3.3:11.6: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
ud3.3:11.7: ānañjena kho bhagavā vihārena etarahi viharatī 'ti
ud3.3:12.1: atha kho āyasmā Ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante paṭhame yāme uṭṭhāy' āsanā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten' añjalim paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud3.3:12.2: abhikkantā bhante ratti, nikkhanto paṭhamo yāmo, ciranisinnā āgantukā bhikkhū.
ud3.3:13.1: dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante majjhime yāme uṭṭhāy' āsanā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten' añjalim paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud3.3:13.6: dutiyam pi kho bhagavā tuṇhī ahosi.
ud3.3:14.1: tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante pacchime yāme uddhate aruṇe nandimukhiyā rattiyā uṭṭhāy' āsanā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten' añjalim paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud3.3:15.1: atha kho bhagavā tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhahitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud3.3:15.2: sace kho tvaṃ Ānanda jāneyyāsi, ettakam pi te na paṭibhāseyya:
ud3.3:15.3: ahañ c' Ānanda imāni ca pañca bhikkhusatāni sabb' eva ānañjasamādhinā nisīdimhā 'ti.
ud3.3:16.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud3.3:17.2: akkoso ca vadho ca bandhanañ ca pabbato
